name: TraceDR
summary: Public Ahrefs Domain Rating tracker with daily snapshots, a leaderboard and 7-day movement history.
description: TraceDR stores daily snapshots of Ahrefs Domain Rating so a domain's rating is visible as history instead of only a current score. It offers a public dashboard with a DR leaderboard and 7-day movers, a domain search, and a personal account for following a chosen list of domains.
contains: Ahrefs Domain Rating history per tracked domain
public dashboard: leaderboard, top movers, 7-day changes
396 domains tracked in the public dashboard
personal account to follow your own domains
